verdicts.justification: The finding's central assertion is false. It claims the DeprecationWarning 'fires only via hyp.reduce; plot/analyze emit nothing' and that plot/analyze 'silently swallow it'. In fact ALL THREE entry points emit it: hyp.plot(...,reduce={'model':'PCA','params':{'whiten':True}}) prints two DeprecationWarnings (analyze.py:192 and plot.py:1756), hyp.analyze(...) prints one (analyze.py:192), and hyp.reduce(...) prints one. So the entry points already AGREE that 'params' is deprecated -- the claimed inconsistency does not exist. (The unrelated fact that the tutorials still teach the deprecated {'params':...} syntax is genuine, but the finding as filed mischaracterizes the runtime behavior.)

align.ipynb cells 10/13/16 compute group1=np.mean(data[:17],0) and group2=np.mean(data[18:],0) where data=hyp.load('weights') has 36 subjects. data[:17] covers indices 0-16 (17 subjects) and data[18:] covers 18-35 (18 subjects); subject index 17 is excluded from both groups. Should be data[:18] and data[18:] for full coverage.
